ops.title: Bound cleanup Status job-window work by its limit
ops.description: Owner /root/ccn_anchor_source_peer; Root coordinates subsequent isolated implementation assignment. Confirmed separate performance finding WS1 at d5a8f34b76e7daf96d38cd37d954e0a0141fd44a, engine.go356-403/1431-1443/1458-1463: global Status(Limit1) walks e.order and performs a map lookup per visited job, appends every completed Job struct, then sorts all completed jobs before slicing the requested window. All-completedN thus costs O(NlogN) time/O(N Job structs) under e.mu despite Limit1; a completed prefix also forces O(N) visits/copies before a late unfinished result. This is in-memory work, not a repeated filesystem journal poll. Existing corrected Linux CI41341139785 artifacts:32 records=0.169584ms warm Status;7422=56.062894ms (load15.721702/3396.986819ms). Race-instrumented synthetic fixtures, no cache flush/live-helper or historical8s-cause claim. Existing allocation regression covers only front-loaded pending jobs. Existing scheduler indexes cannot directly serve Status because they exclude phases/permanent blocks that reports include. Candidate: private all-unfinished Seq-order and completed Updated/Seq-order keys built at load and maintained through put/dequeue, reusing scheduleKey/orderedKeys/byFinish/clone/reported; consume only returned keys. Preserve all Damaged output, so total output cost still includes damaged count/payloads. Do not silently add an ID tie-break: equal Updated+Seq currently compare0 under unstable SortFunc; refute exact order and mutation/prune tradeoffs. Next executable step: Root accepts source review and assigns isolated candidate/reference/refuter work; this review lane makes no source edits or runtime probes. Source evidence FE/ccx-warm-status-limit-source-evidence.json SHA6836ae35c93b67bca4b51e953b18179076a89352645d8357b05e0ab7232eb465. Separate from CaptSource675 diagnostic ownership and OPEN96258 historical attribution; no version allocation/force closure.

ops.text: Retain exact d5a8 source mechanism and corrected private Linux32/7422 warm Status evidence, distinct from historical8s cold-timeout attribution and old canceled-head artifacts.

Implement a bounded job-window Status read using private ordering indexes while preserving full DTO, filters, ordering/ties, selected JobID/UnknownJob/Await, Omitted/Damaged, clone isolation, pause/hold/governor, Cancel/pruning/waiter and mutation semantics; resolve any equal-comparator order tradeoff explicitly before changing it.

Independent finder/refuter and exact-head full CI validate legacy-reference equivalence plus fixed-limit scaling/allocation/read work on all-completed, long-completed-prefix and mixed histories; grade index mutation/load/pruning costs too, with no workload or threshold weakening.

Carry the accepted fix through normal merge, C1-coordinated official publication, supported installation and an actual fresh private-helper warm Status affected proof bound to genuine running image bytes. Claim live production adoption only after a separately source-proven Root authority/protected-boundary packet; never equate CLI update or private proof with loaded production repair.
